title: RedRedRed
description: An expansive content expansion adding nearly 200 custom items and blocks, from unique thematic sets to helpful utility tools.
body:
# Overview

RedRedRed is an expansive content expansion for Minecraft built on NeoForge using MCreator. The project introduces nearly 200 custom items and blocks to the game, ranging from structured thematic sets to high-efficiency utility tools. 

*Note: This project is in active development. Features, textures, and balances may change in future versions. Some updates may take longer to release due to the development environment.*

# Requirements & Compatibility

* **Mod Loader:** NeoForge
* **Backup Recommended:** As this is an active development project, please backup your worlds before installing or updating.

# Key Features

* **The Red Collection:** A full suite of red-themed content, including Red Gems, Red Wood types, custom Red Tools, and Red Armor sets.
* **Experimental Custom Portals:** Certain custom blocks in this mod serve as portal frame components, allowing players to build custom portal frames and discover unique item-based ignition mechanics.
* **Utility & Tools:** Includes high-efficiency equipment like the Instamine 3000 pickaxe for rapid block clearing and the custom Yeetness enchantment (scalable up to level 255).
* **Miscellaneous Additions:** A variety of extra blocks and mechanics, including the Lampight block, unique status effects like the Dummy Potion, and the TPOT Music Disc (Music credit: jacknjellify).
